svg.title: The highlights pane: colored cards for important lines, warnings, Claude's next steps, done items and tips

g.text: Every colored line from the conversation in a side pane, grouped into cards: important,
warnings, next steps, done and tips. Copy any line; the pane never enters Claude's context.
